sources.identity: Both official page PDF links returned the same 500496-byte seven-page combined registration notice and charter. One distinct source, not two independent confirmations.

facts.claim: Current document identifies the 2026 seventh MathorCup mathematics application challenge big-data competition; organizer is the Chinese society stated in the official document.

Registration deadline 2026-10-23 12:00; first round 2026-10-23 18:00 through 2026-10-30 20:00; second round 2026-12-04 18:00 through 2026-12-11 20:00. Times transcribed from current organizer document; no scheduler or registration action.

Notice says two industry-derived big-data problems with related data, choose one; problems announced at competition start on official and registration sites. No current competition raw problem/data acquired in this audit.

Electronic paper, result dataset and source code are described. Written programs also belong in the paper appendix and in support materials; the notice distinguishes unspecified optional support from required program files. Page 3 names paper/promise PDFs and rar/zip attachments. Detailed current submission specification remains to acquire.
Charter limits platform submission to one per team per day. This is not an internal research, code correction or local experiment retry cap; no platform submission performed.

Four evaluation aspects are coherent and concise paper explanation, complete/correct/efficient matching code, problem-relevant test-dataset metrics, and meaningful method/data-analysis innovation. Metrics mentioned are examples, not an instruction to impose forecasting/classification on every problem.
Published journal sources can be cited with attribution; plagiarism and other unfair practices prohibited. Organizer retains interpretation/amendment authority.

Notice signature dated 2026-08-10; attached charter revised August 2026 and states operation from 2026. Official list dates these notices 2026-09-03. These dates serve different roles, not a contradiction.

unknowns: No explicit generative-AI/external-assistance clause identified in the seven-page document actually read; absence is not permission or prohibition.
Exact 2026 submission specification, AI-specific supplements and registration-platform updates not yet acquired.
Actual current problem/data and their particular target/metric/domain are not acquired; announcement schedule is not proof that no early material exists anywhere.
Current training/workflow results do not certify score, prize or future competition performance.
